dogecoin.text: @JeanneDeBit It's ironic, because they're the only gov that made DogeCoin an official currency in the 2016 cycle!

DogeCoin is year is what Ripple (XRP) was in 2017. People bought in at $0.5 and $0.9 thinking XRP will go to $10 & $50, when it actually stopped at $3.4 when the market cycle had ended & they didn't sell.

Some people in Kuwait lost their homes, their cars, & some ended in jail.

Are there people who profited from DogeCoin? Sure, those who got in very early (Jan 2021 or earlier).

Those joining now, & thinking it'll hit $10, are delusional.

I've seen people lose 70,000 KWD ($230k) over such irrational thinking.
